overview.description: Quinze is an early French banking game of Spanish origin where players aim for fifteen points or as close as possible.

rules.objective: Reach 15 points or come closer to 15 than the opponent without exceeding the target.
rules.gameplay: A banker-player structure compares hands by point total. Cards are drawn toward the target of 15, making Quinze a direct ancestor of twenty-one and blackjack-style banking games.
keyRules: The target total is 15 rather than 21.
Aces are low in the traditional ace-low description.
The game is primarily chance-driven and historically treated as a banking game.
